4.A. History and Development of the Company
Our Corporate Structure and History
SuperX AI Technology Limited (formerly known as “Super X AI Technology Limited” and “Junee Limited”) was incorporated on August 25, 2021 as a BVI business company limited by shares under the laws of the BVI. The Company is authorized to issue an unlimited number of Ordinary Shares of no par value per share. SuperX is a holding company and does not conduct any business operations of its own. We conduct our operations through our subsidiaries, which are located principally in Singapore, Japan and the United States, and we also have investment holding and other subsidiaries in other jurisdictions. A list of our subsidiaries and joint ventures as of June 30, 2026 is filed as Exhibit 8.1 to this annual report. Through our subsidiaries, we provide AI infrastructure solutions, including AI servers and related IT equipment, related deployment, warranty and maintenance services, and AI cloud computing and AI model API services.
On June 2, 2025, SuperX effected a rebrand, changing its company name from “Junee Limited” to “Super X AI Technology Limited” and changing its principal business to AI infrastructure solutions. On October 10, 2025, we effected a further change of our company name from “Super X AI Technology Limited” to “SuperX AI Technology Limited.” The name changes were effected pursuant to resolutions of our board of directors and the filing of a notice of change of name with the Registrar of Corporate Affairs of the British Virgin Islands. On October 20, 2025, we adopted an amended and restated memorandum and articles of association.
In April 2025 and May 2025, the Company acquired 51% and the remaining 49%, respectively, of SuperX Industries Pte. Ltd. (f/k/a MindEnergy AI Technology Pte. Ltd.), a Singapore company. On March 12, 2025, SuperX entered into a share purchase agreement with the shareholder of MindEnergy AI Technology Pte. Ltd. to acquire 51% of its issued and outstanding shares. MindEnergy AI Technology Pte. Ltd. is now wholly owned by the Company and has been renamed SuperX Industries Pte. Ltd.
On May 23, 2025, the Company acquired SuperX AI Company Limited, a Hong Kong company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
On June 13, 2025, the Company acquired SuperX Singapore, a Singapore company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
On September 1, 2025, the Company incorporated SuperX Industries Co., Ltd., a Japanese company and wholly owned operating subsidiary of the Company. SuperX Japan operates our Japan Global Supply Center in Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, Japan, as described under “4.B. Business Overview”.
On September 3, 2025, the Company incorporated SuperX AI Solution Limited, a BVI company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, which holds our interests in our Singapore joint ventures and in SuperX MicroInference.
On September 9, 2025, the Company incorporated SuperX USA, a Nevada corporation and wholly owned operating subsidiary of the Company.
On July 15, 2022, the Company amended its memorandum and articles of association to authorize the issuance of an unlimited number of Ordinary Shares with par value of $1.00 per share.
On September 5, 2022, the Company amended its memorandum of association to authorize the issuance of an unlimited number of Ordinary Shares, no par value, and to effectuate (i) a redemption of existing 1,000 shares at par value of $1.00 per share in exchange for the issuance of 1,000 Ordinary Shares of no par value; and (ii) a split of the issued and outstanding Ordinary Shares at a ratio of 1:10,714.286 shares, resulting in the 10,714,286 Ordinary Shares issued and outstanding after the redemption and share split.
On June 8, 2023, our Board approved a forward split of the Company’s shares at a ratio of 1:1.225, resulting in 13,125,000 Ordinary Shares of no par value outstanding following the split. On July 14, 2023, our Board approved a reverse split at the ratio of 1.225:1, resulting in 10,714,286 outstanding following the reverse split.
Principal Capital Expenditures and Divestitures
Our principal divestitures during the three fiscal years ended June 30, 2026 were the sale of our 100% equity interest in Excellent Prospect Investment Holding Limited on July 31, 2025 for a consideration of US$480,000, and the sale of our 100% equity interest in OPS Interior Design Consultant Limited, or OPS HK, through which we conducted our former interior design and fit-out business, to three of its directors, under a sale and purchase agreement dated May 4, 2026, which was completed on May 7, 2026, for a consideration of US$2,396,507, satisfied by the purchasers’ assumption of an intercompany payable owed by us to OPS HK in the same amount. The results of OPS HK are presented as discontinued operations in our consolidated financial statements for all periods presented, and we recognized a gain on its disposal of US$562,135. Following the disposal of OPS HK, we have no material operations in Hong Kong: our remaining subsidiaries there are investment holding companies.
Our capital expenditures, consisting of purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets, amounted to nil, US$297,599 and US$5,523,121 for the fiscal years ended June 30, 2024, 2025 and 2026, respectively. We also made prepayments for the acquisition of property and equipment and land use rights of US$331,324 and US$1,527,076 in the fiscal years ended June 30, 2025 and 2026, respectively.
In addition, during the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, we invested US$2,640,957 in equity method investees under our joint venture arrangements, subscribed US$3,000,000 for a 51% interest in SuperX MicroInference and, on the exercise of the first put option, acquired a further 24.5% interest in SuperX MicroInference for US$750,000 in cash and 70,450 Ordinary Shares. As of June 30, 2026, our remaining capital commitment to our joint venture in mainland China was US$1,921,055.
There have been no public takeover offers by third parties in respect of our Ordinary Shares, and we have made no public takeover offers in respect of the shares of any other company, during the last and current fiscal year.
The SEC maintains an internet site at www.sec.gov that contains reports and other information regarding issuers, such as us, that file electronically with the SEC. Our filings with the SEC are available on that site. See also “Item 10.H. Documents on display.”
Initial Public Offering (“IPO”)
On April 19, 2024, the Company consummated its IPO of 2,000,000 Ordinary Shares, no par value per share. Subsequently, on May 31, 2024, the underwriter exercised its over-allotment option to purchase an additional 263,068 Ordinary Shares of the Company at the public offering price of US$4.00 per share. The closing for the sale of the over-allotment shares took place on June 3, 2024. The IPO and the exercise of the over-allotment option resulted in net proceeds of US$7,861,876, after deducting underwriting discounts and offering expenses of US$1,190,396 from gross proceeds of US$9,052,272.
Equity Incentive Plan
On August 1, 2024, the Board of Directors of the Company approved and adopted an equity incentive plan (the “2024 Equity Incentive Plan” or the “2024 Plan”), which became effective on August 1, 2024. For details of the 2024 Plan, see “Item 6. Directors, Senior Management and Employees - 6.B. Compensation - 2024 Equity Incentive Plan.”
As of June 30, 2026, no Ordinary Shares remained available for future awards under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan. For information on awards outstanding under our equity incentive plans, see “Item 6. Directors, Senior Management and Employees - 6.B. Compensation.”
On July 15, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Company approved and adopted an equity incentive plan (the “2025 Equity Incentive Plan” or the “2025 Plan”), which became effective on July 15, 2025. For details of the 2025 Plan, see “Item 6. Directors, Senior Management and Employees - 6.B. Compensation - 2025 Equity Incentive Plan.”
The 2025 Equity Incentive Plan provides for the issuance of up to 8,000,000 Ordinary Shares, of which 2,689,124 Ordinary Shares remained available for future awards as of June 30, 2026. On August 4, 2025, we granted options to purchase 3,526,000 Ordinary Shares at an exercise price of US$15.00 per share to certain employees under the 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. On November 11, 2025, we granted options to purchase 60,000 Ordinary Shares at an exercise price of US$30.00 per share to an employee under the 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. As of June 30, 2026, options to purchase 3,211,500 Ordinary Shares and restricted share units in respect of 391,383 Ordinary Shares were outstanding under our 2024 Equity Incentive Plan and 2025 Equity Incentive Plan.
